run_encoder_analysis: run the encoder analysis tool to compute cross-lingual sentence retrieval accuracy for multiple languages
compute_dist_neighbors: compute cosine similarity between source and target sentence embeddings and return top-k nearest neighbors
load_embeddings_from_files: load sentence embeddings and texts from binary embedding files and sentence shard files across multiple languages

review_compute_dist_similarity: review the compute_dist function to understand how it normalizes embeddings and computes cosine similarity matrices
